HomePage.heroDescription: Discover verified jobs across Technology, Manufacturing, Sales, Logistics, Creative, and Healthcare sectors. Simple OTP and email access, verified MSME profiles, and guaranteed candidate privacy.
HomePage.searchKeywordPlaceholder: Job title, skill (e.g. CNC, React, Sales, Logistics)
HomePage.featuredSubheading: Active openings from verified MSMEs, industrial clusters, and tech firms nationwide.
HomePage.msmeDescription: Over 70% of industrial employment originates from micro, small, and medium enterprises. JobsClick provides manufacturing and service units with direct access to certified vocational and technical candidates without recruitment middlemen.
HomePage.howItWorksSubheading: A secure, streamlined employment workflow built specifically for the Indian workforce.
HomePage.step1Desc: Sign up in seconds using your mobile number, Google account, or email. Employers sign in with their Udyam registration.
HomePage.step2Desc: Browse openings filtered by industry category, city, salary, and trade. Apply directly with your authenticated digital profile.
HomePage.step3Desc: Employers review skills and qualifications without raw contact numbers exposed, protecting candidate data from unsolicited spam.
HomePage.institutionDescription: Placement officers can upload entire student rosters via simple CSV spreadsheet. Students receive instant verification links, create digital CVs, and get matched to regional industries.
